Name: Classy Pam Dialogue Mod
Author: Thisismyusername3
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Changes how Pam talks to have a more classy, sweet tone. Edits regular dialogue and event dialogue to match up with the new tone.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Just FYI, this is my first mod, so let me know if you notice any issues![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Install Content Patcher.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip into mods folder (unless on Android, in which case follow Android modding instructions).[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
The screenshot included is from Android game, as that's what I'm mainly focused on modding for at the moment. The mod should work on PC though, as it's just a Content Patcher mod. Screenshot also displays Bog's UI and a Portrait/Sprite edit for Pam that I've worked on as a personal project that I won't be sharing publicly, as it's based on Nyapu version of Alissa from RSV. This mod only includes my own dialogue changes and does not include any other edits or assets from other mods.

Also, I did use AI to generate a different tone for some of the dialogue but with the same content, so she says the same things but in the new tone. I used my brain for some of the dialogue changes, though.
